limitations: Component measurements do not establish application-level benefit.
Integrated artifact incorporates all session changes; this comparison does not attribute their separate contributions.
The numeric control executes 32 million iterations to reduce Date.now quantization. The sloppy loop functions are called eight times per process and exercise function-frame on-stack tiering.
Peak RSS is an OS high-water observation; no post-GC heap or pause measurement is inferred from it.

inherited_constructor_behavior.description: Invalid byteOffset and an already detached buffer still cause a supplied byteLength object to coerce before the constructor throws. This behavior predates the DataView access optimization and is unchanged by the isolated candidate. Production constructor ordering is outside this optimization.

artifact_preparation.method: shutil.copy2 of BOTH source executables into new files in the same fresh /tmp directory before execution
artifact_preparation.reason: Normalize executable fault-around/page-cache residency; original linker output and copied executable had different resident page coverage despite matching bytes

rss_method: Engine post-exec /proc VmHWM sampled every3ms; wait4 ru_maxrss retained separately because it may include inherited pre-exec parent RSS.
hash_method: SHA-256 streamed in1MiB chunks; executable bytes are never retained in parent memory.

regression_policy.rule: A stable timing component is provisionally regressed when median time increase exceeds3% and the paired95% interval lies above parity.

performance_acceptance.resource_gate: No stable wall/CPU/peakRSS loss exceeds3% with paired95% interval excluding parity.
